note: Caps checked by `npm run perf:check` (scripts/perf.mjs --budget). Only the numbers that do not depend on the machine are caps: draw calls, triangles, textures, geometries, heap, download. They sit about 10% over the 2026-11-06 baseline, so a PR that adds cost fails and must raise the cap on purpose, with a line in docs/decisions.md. Frame times are not capped here: headless Chromium uses SwiftShader (a software GPU), so they are relative only. See docs/perf/baseline.md for the targets on real devices.
